# ScienceDaily

> Breaking science news and research discoveries across medicine, biology, physics, and earth sciences with daily updates from leading institutions worldwide.

ScienceDaily aggregates the latest peer-reviewed research findings and press releases from universities and research institutions, making cutting-edge scientific discoveries accessible to general audiences. The site covers major research fields including medical breakthroughs, cancer immunotherapy, artificial intelligence, quantum physics, paleontology, and planetary science.

## Latest Medical Breakthroughs

- [He survived 48 hours without lungs and lived](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260317064507.htm): Patient survives 48 hours without lungs using artificial lung system
- [Scientists inject one tumor and watch cancer vanish across the body](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260315225121.htm): Redesigned CD40 agonist antibody shows promising cancer immunotherapy results
- [New drug protects liver after intestinal surgery and boosts nutrient absorption](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260318033134.htm): Compound protects liver and improves nutrient absorption post-intestinal surgery
- [Common pesticide may more than double Parkinson's disease risk](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260315225125.htm): Chlorpyrifos pesticide linked to 2.5x increased Parkinson's disease risk
- [The surprising cancer link between cats and humans](https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2026/03/260318033143.htm): Cancer genetics overlap between cats and humans discovered by research institutions
